about: Experience MediEvil™ II originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters. Take an eerie romp on the dark side with the undead hero, Sir Daniel Fortesque as he returns to battle the evil occultist Palethorn in a gothic, twisted version of Victorian London.
-A merciless arsenal: Gatling gun, bomb, blunderbuss, pistol, torch and many more weapons to dismember, squash, burn or blow up the most peculiar cast of villains.

-New interesting main characters: An Egyptian Princess love interest, a Mad Professor who advises Sir Dan on his missions, Winston-the all knowing help ghost and The Spiv-a wheeling dealing shop mechanism.

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: The gothic journey to die for.
